channel.title: Syria, This Is Not The End
channel.desc: It is a collection of testimonies of faith and courage by Christians who endured war conditions for years. The Syrian people have suffered and are suffering in their daily lives because of the economic embargo. In the midst of this misery, Father Hugo, a Catholic priest, and his team have developed an aid network that meets the basic needs of the most vulnerable people. But beyond material aid, what makes a difference is the glimmer of hope that their Christian faith brings. This very moving testimony shows how adversity can strengthen faith, hope and love. (30 minutes).
